segments.thig6.5:1.3: Vaṇṇarūpena sampannā, dhītā majjhassa [meghassa (sī.), meghissa (syā.)] atrajā.
segments.thig6.5:2.3: Pitu me pesayī dūtaṃ, detha mayhaṃ anopamaṃ.
segments.thig6.5:3.3: Tato aṭṭhaguṇaṃ dassaṃ, hiraññaṃ ratanāni ca.
segments.thig6.5:5.3: Nisinnā āsane tasmiṃ, phusayiṃ tatiyaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.thig6.5:6.3: Ajja me sattamī ratti, yato taṇhā visositā”ti.
